title: Power
practice: Derive the key formula for Power.
keyPoints: Connection of Power to other topics
summary: Power covers essential principles and applications.
importantStatements: Power is the rate of doing work: P = dW/dt = F·v.
The SI unit of power is the watt (W): 1 W = 1 J/s.
For constant force and velocity: P = Fv cos θ (dot product).
Average power = total work / total time; instantaneous power = F·v at that instant.
In rotational motion: P = τω (torque × angular velocity).
importantNotes: Power is based on fundamental principles.
examNotes: Focus on Power problems - significant marks.

importantStatements: शक्ति भनेको कार्य गर्ने दर हो: P = dW/dt = F·v।
शक्तिको SI एकाइ वाट (W) हो: 1 W = 1 J/s।
स्थिर बल र वेगको लागि: P = Fv cos θ (डट उत्पादन)।
औसत शक्ति = कुल कार्य / कुल समय; तत्काल शक्ति = त्यस क्षणमा F·v।
घूर्णन गतिमा: P = τω (टर्क × कोणीय वेग)।

notes: Power (noun): rate of doing work. Plural: powers.
importantStatements: In physics, 'power' is a scalar quantity, not a vector.
The term 'power' is often used in common parlance, but has a precise scientific definition.
